description: A dim, dark room with a crowd of people in the foreground holding up smartphones, all pointed at a large flat-screen TV. The TV screen is black with a single glowing square of blocky black-and-white QR-style pixels, outlined in a soft blue and pink glow. The scene is painted in a dark, expressive oil style, with pictures hanging on the walls and a speaker and shelves at the sides. No readable letters or numbers are visible.
